# Navy and Cognac: before and after

Screenshots of the four headline screens, before and after the redesign, in
both themes, on a desktop (1440 × 900) and a phone (390 × 844). The design
tokens and rules are in [THEME.md](../../THEME.md).

"Before" is commit `24c240f`. Both sets were taken the same way, against the
live backend, on the same day.
